# Google Ranking Cheatsheet

## Write Blog Posts That Drive Traffic

## I. Relevance

### 1\. Primary Keyword Research

- Check monthly search volume (aim for 100-500 searches)
- Analyze keyword difficulty (start with KD under 30)
- Verify search intent matches blog format
- Check if top 10 results include blog posts
- Check CPC value for commercial potential
- Study top 10 results for content type validation

???? More resources: [Complete Keyword Strategy Guide](https://seowind.io/keyword-strategy-guide/) developed by [Tom Winter](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tom-winter/) and [Davor Bomestar](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davorbomestar/)

### 2\. Long-tail Optimization

- Target phrases with 3+ words
- Target question-based searches
- Check autocomplete suggestions
- Mine Reddit/Quora for topics
- Analyze forum discussions for patterns
- Identify uncovered subtopics
- List commonly asked questions
- Check “People Also Ask” boxes
- Find unique data opportunities
- Track seasonal keyword trends
- Consider geographic variations

### 3\. User Intent Optimization

- Map keywords to user journey stages
- Create content for each funnel stage
- Match content format to user needs
- Address common pain points
- Provide clear next steps
- Include relevant use cases
- Create supporting content pieces
- Test different content angles

### 4\. Keyword implementation

- Primary: Use in first 100 words, H1, meta title
- Secondary: 2-3 related keywords throughout content
- Long-tail: Target 2-3 specific phrases
- LSI: Include 5-7 semantic variations
- Density: Keep under 2% for main keyword
- Featured Snippet: Answer key questions in 40-60 words
- Research: Use tools like Ahrefs/SEMrush for volume/difficulty

## II. Quality

### 5\. Create E-E-A-T Content

- Create comprehensive, in-depth information
- Provide original research and unique insights
- Display author credentials prominently
- Ensure 100% unique content
- Update content every 6-12 months
- Aim for at least 2-3 images for a 1,000-word post
- Link to authoritative sources
- Feature expert quotes and opinions
- Create content upgrades
- Develop location-specific content when relevant

???? For more, go to [The E-E-A-T Content Checklist](https://seowind.io/eeat-content-checklist/) developed by [Tom Winter](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tom-winter/) and [Audrey Chia](https://www.linkedin.com/in/audrey-chia/).

### 6\. Content Structure

- H1: One unique main heading with primary keyword
- H2-H6: Organize subtopics logically
- Meta Title: Primary keyword in first 60 characters
- Meta Description: 150-160 characters with CTA
- URLs: Short, keyword-rich, hyphenated
- Internal Links: 3-5 relevant links per 1000 words
- Image SEO: Alt Text, File Names, Image Sitemaps
- Implement schema markup for content type
- Structure content for featured snippets

### 7\. Content Enrichment

- Add interactive elements (polls, surveys)
- Include multimedia (videos, infographics)
- Implement practical tools (calculators, tables)
- Place strategic CTAs
- Create downloadable resources
- Social proof (testimonials, reviews, user-generated content)
- Custom illustrations/branded visuals
- Tweetable quotes/shareable snippets
- Add comparison tables
- Include case studies

## III. Content Maintenance

### 8\. Regular updates

- Audit: Quarterly content review
- Updates: Add new data, remove outdated info
- Thin: Merge or improve posts under 300 words
- Links: Fix broken links immediately
- Images: Compress all images, add alt text
- Monitor: Weekly ranking checks
- Adapt: Update per major algorithm changes

## IV. Authority

### 9\. Internal Linking

- Link to relevant content within first 300 words
- Add 3-5 internal links per 1000 words
- Use descriptive anchor text
- Link to cornerstone content
- Create topic clusters
- Maintain flat site architecture
- Implement breadcrumb navigation

### 10\. External Link Building

- Focus on relevant industry sites
- Target domains with DR 50+
- Vary anchor text naturally
- Build relationships via outreach
- Create linkable assets
- Monitor competitor backlinks

### 11\. Digital PR Strategies

- Create newsworthy data studies or industry surveys
- Analyze industry trends
- Present unique findings
- Package data into shareable infographics
- Prepare expert commentary on breaking news
- Host virtual events or webinars
- Share unique insights on LinkedIn
- Create original research reports

### 12\. Link Management

- Check for broken links monthly
- Remove toxic backlinks
- Update outdated external links
- Monitor link velocity
- Track referring domains
- Analyze link quality metrics

## V. User Experience

### 13\. Readability Enhancement

- Readability: Aim for Grade 8 reading level
- Break content into clear sections
- Include white space between paragraphs
- Use descriptive subheadings
- Highlight key points in bold

### 14\. Navigation and Layout

- Clear menu structure, breadcrumbs
- Mobile: No horizontal scrolling, readable fonts (16px+)
- Scan: Use bullets, numbers, sections
- Layout: 50-75 characters per line
- CTAs: Place above fold and end of content

## VI. Technical performance

### 15\. Technical SEO Fundamentals

- Install SSL certificate
- Submit XML sitemap to Search Console
- Optimize robots.txt
- Implement proper canonical tags
- Set up structured data markup
- Configure proper HTTP status codes

### 16\. Speed Optimization

- Keep server response time under 200ms
- Compress images to under 100KB while maintaining quality
- Minify CSS, JavaScript, and HTML files
- Implement browser caching (min 1 month)
- Use a CDN for global accessibility

### 17\. Mobile Optimization

- Ensure responsive design across all devices
- Keep menu navigation simple and thumb-friendly
- Maintain minimum 16px font size for readability
- Eliminate horizontal scrolling
- Test on multiple devices and browsers
- Keep important elements above the fold

### 18\. Core Web Vitals

- Achieve LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) under 2.5 seconds
- Maintain FID (First Input Delay) under 100 milliseconds
- Keep CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) under 0.1
- Monitor via Google Search Console
- Fix issues flagged in PageSpeed Insights
- Regular testing on mobile and desktop

### 19\. Content Accessibility

- Implement WCAG guidelines
- Add proper heading structure
- Ensure color contrast compliance
- Provide text alternatives for images
- Make videos accessible (captions)
- Enable keyboard navigation
- Test with screen readers

## VII. Performance Analytics

### 20\. Track and optimize

- Set Up Google Analytics
- Use Google Search Console
- Set Up Goals and Events
- Adjust your strategy based on data insights to improve results.
